Administrator Job Details Posted 05 October 2026 Location Auckland Job type Contracting & Consulting Solutions Discipline IT, Transformation & Digital Reference 133673 Job Description Data Engineer / WhereScape Administrator Contract ASAP Start to 18 December (likely to be extended) We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer / WhereScape Administrator to hit the ground running and support our client’s major WhereScape migration and platform upgrade project. Exposure to Databricks would be beneficial, but WhereScape migration experience is what we are really looking for. A significant component of this role involves the administration and migration of the WhereScape RED platform, including RED version upgrades, repository migration, scheduler re-establishment on new infrastructure, and environment promotion activities. Previous experience delivering similar WhereScape upgrade projects is essential. Ideally, you will be based in Auckland, but remote working options could be possible for the right candidate. About the Role You will play a key role in supporting the migration and upgrade of an existing WhereScape environment onto a modernised platform. The project includes upgrading infrastructure, migrating workloads, and ensuring ongoing stability and performance of critical data integration capabilities. The environment is transitioning to an updated version of WhereScape RED, with much of the existing platform currently operating in maintenance mode while broader data integration initiatives continue across the organisation. Key Responsibilities Support the delivery of a WhereScape migration project Assist with platform upgrade and migration activities Work with stakeholders to ensure a smooth transition to the new environment Identify and resolve migration-related issues and risks Contribute to data platform optimisation and ongoing support activities Collaborate with technical teams across infrastructure and data domains Please Note: You must be available to start ASAP. To be considered for this role you need to be in New Zealand and have the legal right to work. Ref: 133673 Beyond Recruitment - IT, Transformation & Digital, connecting IT talents with IT opportunities. Visit www.beyond.co.nz for more roles and information.
